turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - b3_supercon_train.csv: 300 real materials, columns `composition`
    (element fractions as a compact formula string) and `target` (the
    measured critical temperature Tc (K)).
  - b3_supercon_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE materials whose critical temperature
    Tc (K) was NOT measured, columns `candidate_id` and `composition`.

Using the training data, predict which candidates have the HIGHEST critical
temperature Tc (K), then select the 5 best candidates from the pool.

Reason from the training data, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
# Analysis

Looking at the training data, the highest Tc materials (100–140 K) are overwhelmingly **layered cuprate superconductors** with specific structural families:

- **Tl/Hg-based "1223" phases**: Tl₂Ba₂Ca₂Cu₃O (110), Tl₁Ba₂Ca₂Cu₃O₈ (123), Hg₁Ba₂Ca₂Cu₃F₀.₆O (130.1), Tl₀.₈Hg₀.₂Ba₂Ca₂Cu₃O₉ (137.4)
- **Pb-doped Bi-Sr-Ca-Cu-O ("2223"/"2234") phases**: Bi₁.₇Pb₀.₃Sb₀.₀₅Sr₂Ca₂Cu₃O (106.2), Bi₁.₇Pb₀.₃Sr₂Ca₁.₉₉Sm₀.₀₁Cu₃O (111.0), Bi₂Pb₀.₄Sr₂Ca₂.₅Cu₃.₅O (105.0), Bi₁.₆Pb₀.₃Te₀.₁Sr₂Ca₃Cu₄O (102.7)

The common thread: **Ba(Sr)₂Ca₂Cu₃ (or Ca₃Cu₄) stoichiometry**, i.e., triple/quadruple CuO₂-layer cuprates, doped with small amounts of Pb/Sb/Sm/Te, consistently gives the highest Tc (100+ K). Doping level matters but small substitutions (≤10-20%) at Ca/Cu sites don't destroy the high-Tc structure.

Scanning the pool for the closest structural/compositional matches to these champion compounds:

- **c046** `Bi1.7Pb0.2Mo0.1Sr2Ca2Cu3O` — nearly identical to the 106.2/111.0 K training entries (Sr2Ca2Cu3 Bi-2223 backbone, Mo instead of Sb/Sm dopant).
- **c097** `Bi1.6Pb0.4Sr2Ca3Cu3.996Ag0.004O` — almost exactly matches the Bi1.6Pb0.3Te0.1Sr2Ca3Cu4O (102.7 K) entry, same Ca3/Cu4 ratio.
- **c081** `Bi3.2Pb0.2V0.6Sr4Ca5Cu7O` — normalizes to Bi2Pb0.13V0.38Sr2.5Ca3.1Cu4.4, same high-layer Bi-Pb-Sr-Ca-Cu family.
- **c034** `Tl2Ba2Ca5Cu6O16` — same Tl2Ba2 "n-layer" family as the 108–137 K Tl-cuprates.
- **c044** `Tl2Ba2Ca0.8Y0.2Cu1.96Co0.04O8` — Tl2Ba2Ca1Cu2 backbone matching Tl2Ba2Ca1Cu2O7 (108 K), with modest Y/Co doping.

These five most closely mirror the compositional signatures of the record-Tc training compounds, so they are predicted to have the highest Tc among the pool.

Final: c046, c097, c034, c081, c044
